import subprocess, sys
cases = [("Hello World", "hello-world"), ("  Many   Spaces ", "many-spaces"), ("Already-ok", "already-ok")]
bad = 0
for text, want in cases:
    try:
        got = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "slug.py", text], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        got = "error: " + str(e)
    ok = got == want
    bad += 0 if ok else 1
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + " slug(%r) = %r, want %r" % (text, got, want))
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
